events.title: Local Artists Open Studios — Friedberg (Hessen)
events.description: Artists across Friedberg (Hessen) open their studios to the public for a weekend of behind-the-scenes art discovery and direct engagement. Over 30 local painters, sculptors, printmakers, ceramicists, and mixed-media artists welcome visitors into their creative workspaces. This is a rare opportunity to see works in progress, discuss techniques directly with the artists, and purchase original pieces without gallery markup. A printed map guides visitors on a self-guided tour through different neighborhoods, with studios marked by colorful flags. Many studios offer mini-workshops where visitors can try their hand at printmaking, clay modeling, or watercolor painting.

events.title: Usingen Frühlingsfest (Spring Festival)
events.description: The Frühlingsfest in Usingen welcomes the spring season with a joyful celebration of nature, renewal, and community. A colorful flower market fills the main square with tulips, daffodils, hyacinths, and flowering shrubs from local nurseries. Live folk music and traditional Schuhplattler dances entertain visitors on the main stage throughout the weekend. Children can plant their own flower seeds in the community garden workshop, learning about nature and sustainability. A farmers' market featuring early-spring produce, honey, and artisanal products runs alongside the festival, with cooking demonstrations using seasonal ingredients.

events.title: Bad Nauheim Intercultural Week
events.description: Intercultural Week in Bad Nauheim celebrates the diversity of the community with a packed program of international events across multiple venues. International food markets, dance performances, film screenings, language workshops, and panel discussions explore themes of migration and cultural exchange. The highlight is the Parade of Nations on Saturday, where community groups in traditional costumes parade through the city center with music and dance. Workshops teach traditional crafts, cooking classes feature cuisines from around the world, and children's activities promote cross-cultural understanding. All events are free and open to everyone, with multilingual guides available at major venues.

events.title: Wiesbaden Summer Night Concert
events.description: The Wiesbaden Summer Night Concert is an enchanting open-air classical music experience held in the historic city center. The Hessian State Orchestra performs works by Mozart, Beethoven, and contemporary German composers under the starlit sky. What makes this concert special is the intimate atmosphere of the candlelit surroundings and the warm summer breeze between the historic buildings. Guests are welcome to bring picnic baskets and blankets, with the concert lasting approximately two hours from 19:30 to 21:30. Wine and sparkling water are available from vendors throughout the venue, and the event is fully wheelchair accessible.

events.title: Oberursel (Taunus) Weihnachtsmarkt (Christmas Market)
events.description: The Oberursel (Taunus) Weihnachtsmarkt is a magical Christmas market set in the historic old town, with wooden stalls, twinkling lights, and the aroma of Glühwein and roasted almonds. Over 50 decorated stalls offer handcrafted gifts, Christmas decorations, regional specialties, and warm winter treats. A large Christmas tree stands in the main square, illuminated with hundreds of lights, and a children's carousel and ice skating rink provide family entertainment. Live Advent concerts from the church choir and brass bands perform daily at 17:00 and 19:00. The market runs from late November through December 23, open daily 11:00-21:00.

events.title: Friedrichsdorf Harvest Festival — Erntedankfest
events.description: The Friedrichsdorf Harvest Festival celebrates the autumn bounty of the Hessian countryside with a traditional Erntedankfest celebration. A parade of decorated tractors, harvest floats, and local Vereine winds through the city streets on Sunday morning starting at 10:00. The main square hosts an agricultural exhibition with farm animals, vintage machinery, and displays of regional crops and produce. Farmers sell their harvest directly to visitors: pumpkins, apples, potatoes, honey, nuts, and homemade preserves. A harvest church service at 09:00 gives thanks for the season's bounty, followed by a communal lunch featuring traditional harvest dishes.

events.title: Wiesbaden Storytelling Festival
events.description: The ancient art of oral storytelling comes alive at the Wiesbaden Storytelling Festival, where professional storytellers from Germany and Europe perform. Programs include fairy tales and folklore for children, historical narratives for adults, and interactive story-building workshops for all ages. Each teller brings a distinctive style, from dramatic theatrical performances to intimate fireside storytelling sessions. The festival celebrates both traditional European tales and contemporary stories reflecting modern life in Hessen. Evening programs feature adult-oriented stories with mature themes, while daytime sessions are family-friendly and engaging.

events.title: Homberg (Efze) Storytelling Festival
events.description: The ancient art of oral storytelling comes alive at the Homberg (Efze) Storytelling Festival, where professional storytellers from Germany and Europe perform. events.title: Darmstadt Long Night of the Museums — After Dark
events.description: The Long Night of the Museums in Darmstadt keeps cultural venues open until 02:00 with special after-dark programming. Each museum creates a unique evening experience: cocktail bars in exhibition halls, live DJs in the foyer, midnight flashlight tours, and outdoor film screenings. A shuttle bus network connects all participating venues, running every 10 minutes on a circular route through the city. One ticket (€18, reduced €12) grants entry to all museums and unlimited shuttle bus rides for the entire night. The atmosphere is festive and social, attracting a mixed crowd of culture enthusiasts, young professionals, and night owls.

events.title: Langen (Hessen) Food Truck Night
events.description: The Langen (Hessen) Food Truck Night brings together Hessen's best mobile kitchens for an evening of culinary diversity and outdoor dining. From traditional German Bratwurst and Currywurst to Korean bibimbap, Mexican tacos, and wood-fired pizza, the variety is extraordinary. Each food truck offers small tasting portions (€3-6) so visitors can sample from multiple vendors throughout the evening. Live DJs and acoustic musicians perform while guests eat at communal tables decorated with fairy lights and fresh flowers. A dedicated kids' corner offers child-friendly activities and a separate menu with smaller, affordable portions.

events.title: Darmstadt Yoga im Park
events.description: Free outdoor yoga sessions in Darmstadt's central park, offered every Saturday morning during the summer months. Classes are suitable for all levels, from complete beginners to experienced practitioners, with modifications offered throughout. The session begins with gentle breathing exercises and warm-ups, progresses through standing postures and balances, and ends with a guided relaxation. Bring your own mat or towel, wear comfortable clothing, and arrive 10 minutes early to find a spot. In case of rain, the class moves to the covered pavilion adjacent to the park café.

events.title: Witzenhausen Open-Air Cinema — Films Under the Stars
events.description: The Witzenhausen Open-Air Cinema transforms the city park into an enchanting movie theater under the open sky for the summer season. The program features a curated selection of recent international hits, German cinema classics, independent films, and family favorites. Screenings begin at sunset (approximately 21:15), with gates opening at 19:00 for picnicking on the lawn before the show. High-quality sound and a large LED screen ensure excellent viewing from every spot, and blankets and cushions are available to rent. In case of rain, screenings move indoors to the adjacent community hall — tickets remain valid regardless of weather.

events.title: Offenbach am Main Chocolate Festival
events.description: Indulge your sweet tooth at the Offenbach am Main Chocolate Festival, a paradise for chocolate lovers of all ages. Artisan chocolatiers from across Germany present their finest creations, from single-origin dark chocolate bars to handcrafted truffles and pralines. Live chocolate-making demonstrations reveal the secrets of tempering, molding, and flavor pairing with fruits, spices, and herbs. Children can design their own chocolate bars in the workshop corner, choosing from dozens of toppings and fillings. A chocolate-and-wine pairing session for adults explores the surprising affinities between fine chocolate and Rheingau wines.

events.title: Bad Homburg vor der Höhe Literature Days
events.description: The Bad Homburg vor der Höhe Literature Days bring together established and emerging authors for a weekend of readings, discussions, and literary discovery. Readings take place in atmospheric venues including the city library, bookshops, cafés, and the historic town hall. The program features fiction, poetry, non-fiction, and a special focus on regional Hessian literature and dialect poetry. Workshops for aspiring writers cover creative writing techniques, publishing strategies, and the art of storytelling. A book market with signed editions and rare finds makes this an essential event for bibliophiles and literary enthusiasts.
events.location: Bahnhofstraße 16, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Rodgau Wine Festival — Rheingauer Weinprobe
events.description: The Rodgau Wine Festival celebrates the finest wines from the Rheingau and Hessische Bergstraße wine regions. Over 30 wineries present their Rieslings, Spätburgunder, Silvaner, and Grauburgunder varieties for tasting and purchase. Sommelier-led tasting sessions help visitors discover the nuances of different vintages and learn proper tasting techniques. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards are available to complement the wines, sourced from local producers. Live piano and jazz music in the evening creates a sophisticated atmosphere, and designated driver packages include non-alcoholic wines and juices.

events.title: Frühlingserwachen in Rüsselsheim am Main
events.description: Frühlingserwachen (Spring Awakening) is Rüsselsheim am Main's celebration of the end of winter and the arrival of warmer days. The main spring market features garden plants, seeds, tools, and expert gardening advice from local nurseries and horticultural societies. Traditional maypole dancing and folk music performances entertain visitors throughout the weekend. A children's egg-painting workshop and an Easter egg hunt in the city park are highlights for families. Local restaurants offer special spring menus featuring wild garlic (Bärlauch), asparagus (Spargel), and young salads.

events.title: Mörfelden-Walldorf Organ Recital Series
events.description: The magnificent pipe organ of Mörfelden-Walldorf's main church serves as the centerpiece for this beloved recital series. Organists from across Europe perform works by Bach, Buxtehude, Franck, and contemporary organ composers, demonstrating the instrument's remarkable range. Each recital lasts approximately 60 minutes and includes a guided tour of the church's architecture and organ mechanism afterward. The program is carefully curated to highlight different registrations and tonal colors of the historic instrument. Admission is free with a suggested donation of €5 to support the organ restoration fund.

events.title: Mörfelden-Walldorf City Festival — Altstadtfest
events.description: The Mörfelden-Walldorf City Festival is the highlight of the summer calendar, transforming the entire Altstadt (old town) into a vibrant celebration. Historic squares become performance stages for live music, theater, dance troupes, and street performers from around the region. Local Vereine (clubs and associations) operate food and drink stalls, offering traditional Hessian specialties at reasonable prices. A children's program with face painting, puppet shows, and craft stations runs daily from 14:00 to 18:00. The festival culminates on Sunday evening with a spectacular fireworks display over the city rooftops at 22:30.

events.title: Darmstadt Comic & Manga Convention
events.description: The Darmstadt Comic & Manga Convention brings together fans of comics, manga, anime, cosplay, and pop culture for a weekend of celebration. Artist Alley hosts illustrators and comic creators selling original artwork, prints, and commissions. The cosplay competition showcases incredible handmade costumes with prizes for best in show, best craftsmanship, and best group. Panels and workshops cover drawing techniques, storytelling, cosplay crafting, and the business of making comics. Vendor hall offers comics, manga, figurines, apparel, and collectibles from major publishers and independent creators alike.

events.title: Grüne Soße Festival Lauterbach (Hessen)
events.description: The Grüne Soße Festival celebrates Hessen's most famous culinary export — the legendary green sauce made from seven fresh herbs. Local restaurants and home cooks compete for the title of best Grüne Soße, with secret family recipes revealed to the public. Visitors can sample dozens of variations served with boiled potatoes, hard-boiled eggs, and Frankfurter Rindswurst. Cooking demonstrations by professional chefs teach the art of herb selection, preparation, and the perfect emulsion technique. Herb markets sell fresh bunches of the seven essential herbs (petersilie, kresse, pimpinelle, borretsch, kerbel, basilikum, sauerampfer) for home cooks to try.

events.title: Rock am Turm — Schlitz Open Air
events.description: Rock am Turm is Schlitz's premier open-air rock concert, featuring a lineup of established German rock bands and emerging artists. The main stage is set against the dramatic backdrop of the city's medieval tower, creating a unique visual spectacle enhanced by professional lighting. Two supporting stages showcase indie, punk, and alternative acts throughout the day, ensuring non-stop music from 14:00 until late. Beer gardens, cocktail bars, and gourmet food stands keep concert-goers refreshed between sets. Camping tickets are available for those who want the full festival experience, with showers and breakfast included.

events.title: Königstein im Taunus Writing Workshop Retreat
events.description: A weekend intensive writing workshop in Königstein im Taunus for aspiring authors, journalists, and creative writers looking to develop their craft. Led by published authors and experienced writing instructors, sessions cover character development, plot structure, dialogue, and revision techniques. Participants work on individual projects with personalized feedback in small group settings of no more than 12 people. The workshop includes free time for writing in inspiring locations around Königstein im Taunus, with optional guided literary walking tours. A public reading on the final afternoon lets participants share their work with a supportive audience.

events.title: Königstein im Taunus Craft Beer Festival
events.description: The Königstein im Taunus Craft Beer Festival showcases over 50 independent breweries from Hessen and neighboring states. From hoppy IPAs and rich stouts to sour ales and experimental brews, the range of styles on offer reflects Germany's vibrant craft beer revolution. Brewers are present at each stand to discuss their philosophy, ingredients, and brewing processes with curious visitors. Brewing workshops on Saturday teach the basics of homebrewing, and guided tasting flights help novices develop their palate. Food pairings from local restaurants match each beer style with complementary dishes, from hearty Bavarian pretzels to gourmet sliders.

events.title: Lauterbach (Hessen) Fahrradtour — Cycle Through the Countryside
events.description: A guided group cycling tour departing from Lauterbach (Hessen) that explores the beautiful Hessian countryside, forests, and nearby villages. The route covers approximately 35km on mostly flat, well-marked bike paths suitable for recreational cyclists with basic fitness. Stops include a historic mill, a traditional Hessian Gasthaus for lunch, and a panoramic viewpoint overlooking the region. The tour is led by experienced guides who share local history, nature facts, and cycling tips throughout the day. Bring your own bike or rent one in advance (€15 per day), and don't forget water, sunscreen, and weather-appropriate clothing.

events.title: Schlitz Nordic Walking Workshop
events.description: Learn the proper technique of Nordic walking in the scenic parks and trails around Schlitz with certified instructors. The workshop covers basic technique, pole selection, warm-up exercises, and structured walking routines for fitness and rehabilitation. Suitable for all ages and fitness levels, Nordic walking provides a full-body workout with minimal joint strain. Poles are provided for participants who don't have their own, and the session includes a guided 5km walk through varied terrain. The workshop lasts approximately 2.5 hours including instruction, practice, and cool-down stretching.

events.description: Karaoke Night at Butzbach's beloved Marktstübchen pub is a weekly tradition where anyone can become a star for a night. A vast songbook with thousands of titles in German, English, and other languages ensures there's something for every taste and vocal ability. The friendly MC keeps the energy high and the queue moving, with regular encore rounds and duet challenges. The pub's cozy atmosphere and supportive crowd make even the most nervous first-timers feel welcome. Special themed nights once a month add extra fun — 80s night, Schlager night, and musical night are particular crowd favorites.

Many vendors offer samples, making it a wonderful opportunity to discover new products and meet the people who grow and make your food. The market runs every Wednesday and Saturday from 07:00 to 13:00 in the main square, year-round. Live music from local musicians adds to the convivial atmosphere, and the adjacent flower market completes the sensory experience.

A floating stage hosts live bands and DJs from afternoon until late evening, with music drifting across the water. Food stalls along the promenade serve everything from grilled fish to ice cream, with plenty of seating areas shaded by umbrellas and trees. The festival is family-friendly with a dedicated children's area including water play, face painting, and craft activities.

This year's thematic focus is 'Climate and Community,' featuring documentaries about sustainability initiatives across Germany. Panel discussions and roundtables bring together filmmakers, activists, and academics for lively debate after selected screenings. A student film competition invites young filmmakers to submit short documentaries, with prizes awarded at the closing ceremony.

A team of independent appraisers offers free verbal valuations of items visitors bring (limit 2 items per person). The market takes place in the historic town hall and adjacent square, with indoor and outdoor sections. Café and food stalls provide refreshments, making it easy to spend a whole morning browsing the eclectic offerings.

events.description: Sunset Salsa Night transforms a Karben rooftop terrace into a tropical dance paradise every Friday evening. A live Latin band and professional DJ alternate sets of salsa, bachata, merengue, and cha-cha from 19:00 until midnight. Free beginners' salsa lesson from 19:00-19:45 helps newcomers learn the basic steps before the main dancing begins. Specialty cocktails, mojitos, and non-alcoholic mocktails are served from the rooftop bar, along with light tapas. The stunning sunset views over Karben's skyline provide a magical backdrop for an unforgettable evening of dance and socializing.

events.title: Limburg an der Lahn Open-Air Cinema — Films Under the Stars

Screenings begin at sunset (approximately 21:15), with gates opening at 19:00 for picnicking on the lawn before the show. High-quality sound and a large LED screen ensure excellent viewing from every spot, and blankets and cushions are available to rent. In case of rain, screenings move indoors to the adjacent community hall — tickets remain valid regardless of weather.

events.title: Dreieich Food Truck Night
events.description: The Dreieich Food Truck Night brings together Hessen's best mobile kitchens for an evening of culinary diversity and outdoor dining. From traditional German Bratwurst and Currywurst to Korean bibimbap, Mexican tacos, and wood-fired pizza, the variety is extraordinary. Each food truck offers small tasting portions (€3-6) so visitors can sample from multiple vendors throughout the evening. Live DJs and acoustic musicians perform while guests eat at communal tables decorated with fairy lights and fresh flowers. A dedicated kids' corner offers child-friendly activities and a separate menu with smaller, affordable portions.

events.title: Kulturmeile Limburg an der Lahn — Museum Night
events.description: Kulturmeile Limburg an der Lahn opens all museums, galleries, and cultural institutions for a special late-night exploration experience. A single ticket grants access to every participating venue from 18:00 until midnight, with special exhibitions, guided tours, and live performances. Shuttle buses connect the major cultural venues along the Kulturmeile route, running every 15 minutes free of charge. Each venue offers a unique program: curator talks, hands-on workshops, live music, or themed cocktails at the museum café. This is a unique opportunity to experience Limburg an der Lahn's cultural scene in a relaxed, festive atmosphere without the usual daytime crowds.
events.location: Am Stadtpark 4, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Fulda Contemporary Art Biennale
events.description: The Fulda Contemporary Art Biennale transforms the city into an open-air gallery with installations in public spaces, parks, and historic buildings. International and German artists present thought-provoking works spanning sculpture, digital art, performance, and immersive multimedia installations. What sets this biennale apart is its dialogue between contemporary art and Fulda's historic architecture, creating unexpected juxtapositions. Curated guided tours are offered daily in German and English, and artist talks provide deeper insights into the creative process. Most installations are accessible 24/7, with indoor exhibitions open from 10:00 to 18:00 (extended hours on Thursday).

events.title: Offenbach am Main Chocolate Festival
events.description: Indulge your sweet tooth at the Offenbach am Main Chocolate Festival, a paradise for chocolate lovers of all ages. Artisan chocolatiers from across Germany present their finest creations, from single-origin dark chocolate bars to handcrafted truffles and pralines. Live chocolate-making demonstrations reveal the secrets of tempering, molding, and flavor pairing with fruits, spices, and herbs. Children can design their own chocolate bars in the workshop corner, choosing from dozens of toppings and fillings. A chocolate-and-wine pairing session for adults explores the surprising affinities between fine chocolate and Rheingau wines.

events.title: Dietzenbach Summer Night Concert
events.description: The Dietzenbach Summer Night Concert is an enchanting open-air classical music experience held in the historic city center. The Hessian State Orchestra performs works by Mozart, Beethoven, and contemporary German composers under the starlit sky. What makes this concert special is the intimate atmosphere of the candlelit surroundings and the warm summer breeze between the historic buildings. Guests are welcome to bring picnic baskets and blankets, with the concert lasting approximately two hours from 19:30 to 21:30. Wine and sparkling water are available from vendors throughout the venue, and the event is fully wheelchair accessible.

events.title: Grünberg Organ Recital Series
events.description: The magnificent pipe organ of Grünberg's main church serves as the centerpiece for this beloved recital series. Organists from across Europe perform works by Bach, Buxtehude, Franck, and contemporary organ composers, demonstrating the instrument's remarkable range. Each recital lasts approximately 60 minutes and includes a guided tour of the church's architecture and organ mechanism afterward. The program is carefully curated to highlight different registrations and tonal colors of the historic instrument. Admission is free with a suggested donation of €5 to support the organ restoration fund.

events.title: Hofheim am Taunus Intercultural Week
events.description: Intercultural Week in Hofheim am Taunus celebrates the diversity of the community with a packed program of international events across multiple venues. International food markets, dance performances, film screenings, language workshops, and panel discussions explore themes of migration and cultural exchange. The highlight is the Parade of Nations on Saturday, where community groups in traditional costumes parade through the city center with music and dance. Workshops teach traditional crafts, cooking classes feature cuisines from around the world, and children's activities promote cross-cultural understanding. All events are free and open to everyone, with multilingual guides available at major venues.

events.title: Marburg Literature Days
events.description: The Marburg Literature Days bring together established and emerging authors for a weekend of readings, discussions, and literary discovery. Readings take place in atmospheric venues including the city library, bookshops, cafés, and the historic town hall. The program features fiction, poetry, non-fiction, and a special focus on regional Hessian literature and dialect poetry. Workshops for aspiring writers cover creative writing techniques, publishing strategies, and the art of storytelling. A book market with signed editions and rare finds makes this an essential event for bibliophiles and literary enthusiasts.

The main spring market features garden plants, seeds, tools, and expert gardening advice from local nurseries and horticultural societies. Traditional maypole dancing and folk music performances entertain visitors throughout the weekend. A children's egg-painting workshop and an Easter egg hunt in the city park are highlights for families. Local restaurants offer special spring menus featuring wild garlic (Bärlauch), asparagus (Spargel), and young salads.

events.title: Kassel Tech Meetup & Start-up Networking
events.description: The Kassel Tech Meetup connects developers, designers, entrepreneurs, and tech enthusiasts for an evening of knowledge sharing and networking. Two featured talks cover current topics in software development, AI, cybersecurity, or digital innovation, followed by Q&A. A 'lightning talk' session gives five attendees 5 minutes each to present a quick idea, project, or lesson learned. Networking over drinks and snacks follows the formal program, with opportunities to find co-founders, collaborators, or job opportunities. The event is free but registration is required due to limited capacity at the venue.

events.title: Dreieich Museum Special Exhibition: Art Nouveau in Hessen
events.description: The Dreieich Museum presents a major special exhibition exploring the Art Nouveau (Jugendstil) movement in Hessen and across Germany. Featuring over 200 objects including furniture, glassware, jewelry, posters, and architectural drawings from 1890-1914. Highlights include works from the Darmstadt Artists' Colony and exquisite pieces from the Wiener Werkstätte. Interactive multimedia stations let visitors design their own Art Nouveau patterns and explore 3D models of lost buildings. The exhibition is accompanied by a rich program of lectures, guided tours, and a Sunday brunch with Art Nouveau-themed menu.

events.title: Mörfelden-Walldorf Writing Workshop Retreat
events.description: A weekend intensive writing workshop in Mörfelden-Walldorf for aspiring authors, journalists, and creative writers looking to develop their craft. Led by published authors and experienced writing instructors, sessions cover character development, plot structure, dialogue, and revision techniques. Participants work on individual projects with personalized feedback in small group settings of no more than 12 people. The workshop includes free time for writing in inspiring locations around Mörfelden-Walldorf, with optional guided literary walking tours. A public reading on the final afternoon lets participants share their work with a supportive audience.

events.title: Rüsselsheim am Main Karaoke Night at the Marktstübchen
events.description: Karaoke Night at Rüsselsheim am Main's beloved Marktstübchen pub is a weekly tradition where anyone can become a star for a night. A vast songbook with thousands of titles in German, English, and other languages ensures there's something for every taste and vocal ability. The friendly MC keeps the energy high and the queue moving, with regular encore rounds and duet challenges. The pub's cozy atmosphere and supportive crowd make even the most nervous first-timers feel welcome. Special themed nights once a month add extra fun — 80s night, Schlager night, and musical night are particular crowd favorites.

events.title: Grüne Soße Festival Butzbach
events.description: The Grüne Soße Festival celebrates Hessen's most famous culinary export — the legendary green sauce made from seven fresh herbs. Local restaurants and home cooks compete for the title of best Grüne Soße, with secret family recipes revealed to the public. Visitors can sample dozens of variations served with boiled potatoes, hard-boiled eggs, and Frankfurter Rindswurst. Cooking demonstrations by professional chefs teach the art of herb selection, preparation, and the perfect emulsion technique. Herb markets sell fresh bunches of the seven essential herbs (petersilie, kresse, pimpinelle, borretsch, kerbel, basilikum, sauerampfer) for home cooks to try.

events.description: Free outdoor yoga sessions in Lauterbach (Hessen)'s central park, offered every Saturday morning during the summer months. Classes are suitable for all levels, from complete beginners to experienced practitioners, with modifications offered throughout. The session begins with gentle breathing exercises and warm-ups, progresses through standing postures and balances, and ends with a guided relaxation. Bring your own mat or towel, wear comfortable clothing, and arrive 10 minutes early to find a spot. In case of rain, the class moves to the covered pavilion adjacent to the park café.

events.title: Rock am Turm — Frankfurt am Main Open Air
events.description: Rock am Turm is Frankfurt am Main's premier open-air rock concert, featuring a lineup of established German rock bands and emerging artists. The main stage is set against the dramatic backdrop of the city's medieval tower, creating a unique visual spectacle enhanced by professional lighting. Two supporting stages showcase indie, punk, and alternative acts throughout the day, ensuring non-stop music from 14:00 until late. Beer gardens, cocktail bars, and gourmet food stands keep concert-goers refreshed between sets. Camping tickets are available for those who want the full festival experience, with showers and breakfast included.

events.title: Dietzenbach Gaming Night — LAN Party & Board Games
events.description: The Dietzenbach Gaming Night is a hybrid event combining PC gaming, console gaming, and tabletop board games under one roof. A BYOC (Bring Your Own Computer) LAN area supports 100+ players for tournaments in popular titles like Counter-Strike, League of Legends, and Rocket League. The board game library features over 200 titles from classic German games to modern strategy games, with game masters to teach rules. Retro gaming stations let visitors play classics from the NES, SNES, Sega Genesis, and arcade machines. Energy drinks, pizza, and snacks are available throughout the night, with the event running from 18:00 to 06:00.

events.title: Hofheim am Taunus Wine Festival — Rheingauer Weinprobe
events.description: The Hofheim am Taunus Wine Festival celebrates the finest wines from the Rheingau and Hessische Bergstraße wine regions. Over 30 wineries present their Rieslings, Spätburgunder, Silvaner, and Grauburgunder varieties for tasting and purchase. Sommelier-led tasting sessions help visitors discover the nuances of different vintages and learn proper tasting techniques. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards are available to complement the wines, sourced from local producers. Live piano and jazz music in the evening creates a sophisticated atmosphere, and designated driver packages include non-alcoholic wines and juices.

Live Advent concerts from the church choir and brass bands perform daily at 17:00 and 19:00. The market runs from late November through December 23, open daily 11:00-21:00.

Local Vereine (clubs and associations) operate food and drink stalls, offering traditional Hessian specialties at reasonable prices. A children's program with face painting, puppet shows, and craft stations runs daily from 14:00 to 18:00. The festival culminates on Sunday evening with a spectacular fireworks display over the city rooftops at 22:30.

Bike safety check stations offer free inspections and minor repairs, and cycling instructors teach children traffic rules in a fun obstacle course. Refreshment stations along the route provide free water, fruit, and granola bars for participants. Rental bikes with child seats and cargo bikes are available for families who don't have their own.

Suitable for all ages and fitness levels, Nordic walking provides a full-body workout with minimal joint strain. Many vendors offer samples, making it a wonderful opportunity to discover new products and meet the people who grow and make your food. The market runs every Wednesday and Saturday from 07:00 to 13:00 in the main square, year-round. Live music from local musicians adds to the convivial atmosphere, and the adjacent flower market completes the sensory experience.

Children can build simple robots, create chemical reactions, explore the solar system in a mobile planetarium, and extract DNA from fruit. Scientists from local universities lead the workshops, explaining complex concepts in age-appropriate, engaging ways. Each child receives a 'Junior Scientist' passport that gets stamped at each station, with a prize for completing all activities. The event is free and runs from 10:00 to 17:00, with a break for lunch served by the school cafeteria.

events.title: Kelkheim (Taunus) Flea Market — Flohmarkt am Fluss
events.description: The Kelkheim (Taunus) Flohmarkt am Fluss is one of the region's largest flea markets, stretching for over a kilometer along the riverbank. Hundreds of private sellers and professional dealers offer everything imaginable: books, vinyl, antiques, clothing, electronics, toys, and household goods. Early birds find the best bargains from 06:00, while the main market is in full swing from 08:00 to 14:00. Bargaining is expected and welcomed — a friendly negotiation is part of the experience. Food trucks, coffee stands, and ice cream vendors keep shoppers fueled throughout the morning.

Prizes include bar tabs, themed gift baskets, and the coveted Golden Brain trophy for the winning team. Specialty beers and cocktails are available at discounted quiz-night prices, and food is served until late. Registration is recommended as tables fill quickly — arrive by 19:30 for a 20:00 start.
